name: Exploring the Alliance
label: Quest
description: Exploring the Alliance: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn.
Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.
